## Specifications

- **NHTSA Campaign Number**: 04V230000 [t1303] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] If corrosion is found on the terminal strip, replace the fuel sending unit entirely. [t1303]
- [Partial] If no corrosion exists but issues persist, apply sealant to the terminal housing to prevent future rust. [t1303]
